insight: Formed by the 2024 Commure–Athelas merger (led by Athelas CEO Tanay Tandon, backed by General Catalyst) at a ~$6B combined valuation.
name: Commure
tagline: AI platform automating healthcare operations end to end.
description: Commure is an AI-native platform that automates healthcare operations across clinical documentation, revenue cycle management, and patient engagement. Its products span ambient AI scribing, dictation, coding and claims, workflow agents, and care-coordination tools, deployed across hundreds of health systems.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary healthcare AI across documentation, RCM, coding, and agents.

edge: Bundles ambient scribe, RCM, coding, and patient engagement into one platform where most rivals cover documentation alone.
cons: Broad suite can mean more to adopt
